description:
Produces the self-contained fat jar that the Python wheel mounts via --jars,
    for Spark 4.2.x / Scala 2.13 (WP-20).

    WHY THIS BUNDLE RECOMPILES THE VERSION-AGNOSTIC LAYERS
    ------------------------------------------------------
    The 3.5 bundles ship api/dispatch/runtime classes compiled against Spark
    3.5.3. Those classes are SOURCE-identical here, but a Spark 4.2 driver
    cannot link against classes whose erased Catalyst descriptors were built
    for 3.5 when the 4.2 Catalyst signatures differ. This module therefore
    recompiles interceptor-api, interceptor-dispatch and interceptor-runtime
    FROM SOURCE (build-helper add-source) against THIS combination's Spark
    4.2.0 / Scala 2.13.18, exactly as the WP-20 spike proved possible, and
    pairs them with the 4.2-compiled shim. mutator-core is pure Java (no Spark
    imports, enforced by the CI gate) and is consumed as the reactor artifact.

    NO PACKAGE RELOCATION
    ---------------------
    Same rationale as the other bundles: relocation would rename the
    PlanMutatorShim interface named in spark.sql.extensions and break the
    ServiceLoader contract. The plugin mounts exactly one bundle per session.

    Verify after building:
      jar tf target/interceptor-spark-4.2_2.13.jar | grep -E \
        "MutatorSparkExtension|MutantRegistry|ShimImpl|META-INF/services"
    All four must be present, and the services file must be named
      META-INF/services/io.github.wpunit13.mutator.api.PlanMutatorShim
    containing the UNRELOCATED implementation class name
    (io.github.wpunit13.mutator.spark42_213.ShimImpl).
